title: MFA Reset With Privileged Access Review

signals.name: MFA device change request
signals.rationale: MFA reset requests should validate identity before restoring access.

signals.name: Privileged access present
signals.rationale: Privileged access changes the risk level of a normal authentication recovery request.

signals.name: Approval evidence incomplete
signals.rationale: Missing or stale approval evidence should prevent fast closure.

baselines.name: Privileged review age
baselines.rationale: Privileged access commonly needs review at least every 30 to 90 days.

baselines.name: MFA failure rate
baselines.rationale: Multiple MFA failures in a short window should trigger verification checks.

baselines.name: Approval completeness
baselines.rationale: Identity changes should have complete verification or approval evidence.

baselines.name: Verification age
baselines.rationale: Older verification evidence should be refreshed before making access changes.

recommended_actions: Document manager approval or approved exception.
Route stale privileged access to the access owner.
escalation_template: Send to IAM with MFA request details, verification status, privileged group review age, and missing approval evidence.
